text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Generate a NEW photorealistic clothing-library product photograph inspired by the described reference, not a copy of a screenshot. Pure opaque white #FFFFFF seamless background, bright soft frontal studio lighting, minimal soft contact shadow, crisp realistic fabric texture, true garment colors, no dramatic shadows. Portrait 2:3 canvas, complete centered objects with generous clear margin. Front-facing straight camera. No people, skin, head, neck, hands, legs, body, visible mannequin, stand, hanger, room, typography, logos, brand marks, watermarks, borders or collage. ONE coordinated CLOTHING-ONLY ensemble on an invisible ghost mannequin: relaxed white cotton button-up shirt with open collar and softly rolled sleeves, casually half tucked into extremely wide washed charcoal-gray denim jeans with authentic seam details and soft stacked hems; pair of white and charcoal low-top sneakers underneath. Preserve a relaxed youthful campus streetwear silhouette. The shirt and pants have natural three-dimensional drape but absolutely no body visible. EXCLUDE ALL accessories: no tie, bag, necklace, belt, keychain or hanging charm. Keep this a single full outfit product image.
